body:
Parent: #2184
Depends on: #1713, #2151, #2181, #2182, #2183

## 原子目标

删除 auth truth correctness 路径中的 hand-signed JWT、Cookie/storage claims手改、direct session/refresh/credential/step-up DB/Redis writes、placeholder credentials、legacy strength/permissions、claim-only step-up、old truth/storage readers、canonical/bypass/legacy fallback与 second producer/verifier。所有 consumers 必须显式声明 #2181 truth class并消费 #2182/#2183 verified canonical/bypass-legacy receipts。

## 固定删除清单

- Node/shell/fixture-private JWT signing、Cookie/storage claim mutation。
- Direct session/refresh/credential/step-up DB/Redis writer与 placeholder credential rows。
- `legacy_mfa`/legacy strength作为 canonical truth。
- 第二 admin permission list、all-full/read-only假映射、missing permission fallback。
- step-up boolean/JWT flag替代 proof row/consume-once。
- Cookie/server duration hardcode或 browser-session持久 Expires。
- refresh重建 auth_time/strength或携带 consumed proof。
- old storage/schema/reader/compat adapter、truth filename/JWT claim推断。
- canonical/bypass/legacy共享 storage/root或 consumer未声明 truth class即默认接受。
- second auth/session producer/verifier与 warning-and-continue。

## 必须交付

1. 建立 `config/testing/auth-truth-consumers.json`，逐 consumer/variant/truth class/permission class/session/credential/proof/Cookie/refresh requirement与 verifier exact映射 #2181–#2183及 #1713 ports。
2. 所有 canonical consumers必须显式声明 eligible truth class与 exact receipt schema/status/revision/digests；bypass/legacy只能进入自身 diagnostic/negative lanes。
3. Admin full/read-only/partial permissions逐 action消费 production permission catalog/verifier，不维护第二 map或把 truth class等同 permission class。
4. Browser-session与 persistent-30d Cookie attributes、server idle/absolute deadlines通过 production serializers/policy exact验证；wall clock、hardcoded days、file exists无 authority。
5. Refresh/revocation/credential deletion保持 original auth context、family/device、old/new token validity、proof consume-once，并只影响绑定 credential/session。
6. Canonical/bypass/legacy storage roots、receipts、consumers物理/逻辑隔离；cross-class/run/source/profile/revision/digest fail closed。
7. Ordinary outputs无 JWT/Cookie/credential/recovery/proof secrets，只保留 controlled class/presence/digest。
8. 不修改 production authentication/session/proof/permission/duration policies。

## 固定约束

- 唯一 truth/receipt authorities：#2181、#2182、#2183 与 #1713 canonical ports。
- 允许修改 legacy writers/readers/consumer declarations/ownership inventory/focused tests。
- 禁止 hand-sign/direct DB/placeholder/bypass/legacy fallback、permission hardcode、allowlist或减少 variants。
- 不修改 #1794。

## 必须测试

1. hand-signed JWT、Cookie/storage claim mutation被拒绝。
2. direct session/refresh/credential/step-up writes与 placeholder credentials失败。
3. JWT strength/MFA/credential state mismatch失败。
4. step-up cross-action/replay/expiry/consume-once失败。
5. full/read-only/partial permission与 new/missing permission drift失败。
6. browser-session/persistent Cookie与 server deadline mismatch失败。
7. refresh auth_time/strength/proof carry与 revocation family/device drift失败。
8. legacy/bypass receipt被 canonical consumer接受失败。
9. filename/JWT claim推断、old reader/compat/second producer失败。
10. cross-class/run/source/profile/revision/tamper与 secret leakage失败。

## 验收条件

- [ ] hand-signed JWT、direct DB/Redis、placeholder credentials、legacy strength、step-up flag active paths为0。
- [ ] hardcoded permissions、duration/refresh drift、old storage/readers/compat/second producer为0。
- [ ] `config/testing/auth-truth-consumers.json` 与 #2181–#2183/#1713双向 exact。
- [ ] `node --test tests/tools/auth-truth-cleanup.test.mjs tests/tools/fixture-receipt.test.mjs` 通过。
- [ ] canonical/bypass/legacy物理/逻辑隔离，secret ordinary leakage=0。
- [ ] 本 PR 未实现 #2695治理或修改 production auth policies。

## 非目标

- #2695 terminal governance/mutation。
- 不实现 #2181–#2183或测试完整 login/admin UI。
- 不修复测试发现的产品缺陷。
title: test(test-fixtures): 删除 auth truth fallback 与 compat path
